meta.name: deepchem
meta.description: Molecular ML with diverse featurizers and pre-built datasets. Use for property prediction (ADMET, toxicity) with traditional ML or GNNs when you want extensive featurization options and MoleculeNet benchmarks. Best for quick experiments with pre-trained models, diverse molecular representations. For graph-first PyTorch workflows use torchdrug; for benchmark datasets use pytdc.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Predict molecular properties like toxicity from structural data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work in chemistry or pharma and need to predict compound properties

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能帮你加载 SMILES/SDF 等分子数据、做分子特征化,训练传统机器学习或图神经网络模型,跑 MoleculeNet 基准,并微调 ChemBERTa 等预训练模型来预测分子性质。
howto.when: 当你要预测分子性质(ADMET、毒性等)、用 MoleculeNet 基准跑实验,或微调预训练模型时触发。

howto.what_en: With DeepChem, Claude can load molecular data (SMILES, SDF), featurize molecules, train traditional ML or GNN models, run MoleculeNet benchmarks, and fine-tune pretrained models like ChemBERTa to predict molecular properties.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to predict molecular properties (ADMET, toxicity), run MoleculeNet benchmark experiments, or fine-tune pretrained models on chemical data.

say_en.text: Train a solubility model on the Delaney dataset and report test scores
say_en.note: Loads the benchmark, trains and evaluates

say_en.text: Split my molecules.csv SMILES with ScaffoldSplitter and train a GCN for activity
say_en.note: Scaffold split avoids leakage, then trains a GNN

say_en.text: Fine-tune ChemBERTa on the BBBP dataset for classification
say_en.note: Downloads the pretrained model and fine-tunes it
